'''Voice of Ra''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Upkeep Phase''': You may cast and exhaust to gain +1 to all [[skill check]]s for the rest of this turn.
